Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: document page frame for the contributing page of a project of the Olympuz family
Primary request: one wide frame for the page that explains how somebody else can help - a second tablet is placed beside the first, so the reader sees room made for their work.
Input images: Image 1 is the immutable Pantheon style reference; Image 2 is the required family-signature column; Image 3 is the project character sheet and Image 4 the project prop sheet - the tablet, the herald staff and the gold ribbon must match those sheets exactly.
Subject: two marble writing tablets of the same size lie side by side on a low marble table at the centre of the frame, each with its single carved groove facing the viewer. One continuous muted-gold ribbon curves down from the upper left and ends inside the groove of the left tablet; the right tablet is empty and waiting. The herald staff rests upright against the right end of the table, its butt on the ground.
Composition/framing: 16:9 landscape. The table with both tablets reads clearly at the centre. A classical white-marble column stands at the far right as the family signature. Generous empty ivory space, no figure in this frame, nothing cropped.
Style/medium: premium restrained 3D marble render, physically plausible materials, warm ivory Apple-like presentation
Lighting/mood: soft daylight from upper left, long gentle shadows, calm. Gold glows softly from within, never lit by a lamp or a hard rim light.
Color palette: ivory #F3EFE8, bright ivory #FBFAF6, white marble, muted gold #C9A87A for the ribbon and the staff only, sky blue #B8D6EA for the ground paths only, charcoal #3E3A36
Constraints:
- Three thin sky-blue paths run flat along the ground from the left edge and end at the foot of the table.
- Both tablets rest on the table, the table rests on the ground, the staff touches the ground. Nothing hovers, everything casts a shadow.
- The two tablets are identical in size and thickness: the second is room made for somebody else, not a smaller copy.
- Preserve the reference style; highest final quality; maximum resolution.
Avoid: figures, faces, rainbow of many colors, prismatic colors, screens, keyboards, cables, brand marks, dark background, black background, neon, purple gradient, smoky cinema lighting, heavy bronze, metallic or plastic marble, watermark, callout labels
Text (verbatim): No readable text, no letters, no digits anywhere in the image.
